common.capitalPerOrder: Up to initial equity/N slots; cap by daily equity minus active committed reservation budgets, never leverage
common.entryPriority: Signal day, then original daily Rank; no Rank4 replacement
common.watchConsumesSlot: From signal close through initial 5 trading-day pending or earlier basket exit
common.MA20wait: Next session first entry only if previous completed TWII >= MA20, within 5 sessions
common.timeframe: Daily OHLC; conservative stop-before-TP; limit fill assumptions unchanged
common.portfolioValuation: Each evening: realized exits at simulated order price plus remaining inventory marked at close less estimated closing costs; idle/unfilled capital included
common.financing: No margin, no interest, no intraday cash recycling, no whole-share board lots; multi-asset signals filtered by slot capacity
common.costs: Buy/Sell commissions 0.1425%; sell tax 0.3%; 0.1% slippage per side
common.exit: 10 trading days max after first fill; +7% TP/-15% SL before costs

warnings: ALL selection rules and regime choices were studied repeatedly using 2026: in-sample, no independent validation.
Stock candidate universe may carry survivor bias, corporate-action effects and OHLC inability to resolve intra-bar order.
Slots represent entire pending/active basket reservation; no intraday immediate freed capital or fourth-ranked replacement.
Capital allocation is a simplified cash-constrained daily paper portfolio with fractional shares, not broker-realistic execution.
MA20 gates use completed index daily close; alternative market session index alignments and Yahoo OHLC adjustments may change outcomes.
As of 2026-10-07; no claim that 2026-10-08/09 trading signals were included.
